artifacts.summary: All 7 phases completed: focus-prompt threading, stop-after-last-forced-phase, per-run cycle budget with durable dispatch_seq, artifact-based forced plan/implement admission, documentation consistency pass, and full-suite/redeploy/consumer-repo confirmation.

completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed three coupled defects in the batch /orchestrate engine: user focus prompts now thread into dispatch files, a forced-phase round now genuinely stops for the rest of a run instead of falling through to status-derived dispatch, and the per-task work-cycle budget now resets every run (with --continue-budget removed) while forced plan/implement admission is now keyed on artifact presence rather than status. Redeployed and confirmed live in a real, separate consumer repository.

memory_candidates.content: jq cannot distinguish 'key never seeded' from 'key seeded then popped to empty array/0' via the `//` operator alone (it only fires on null/false). The durable fix pattern: a sibling boolean marker map seeded with the SAME `//=` idempotence as the primary field (e.g. `.forced_round_seeded[$t] //= true` beside `.queue[$t] //= $initial`), then branch three ways: non-empty / empty-and-marked / unmarked. A two-way `if length > 0 ... else fall through` conflates the last two and silently reintroduces a stale-state bug.

When a durable per-task guard file's counter must stop being cumulative-across-invocations (a per-run reset) while a DIFFERENT field on the SAME file must still durably persist across invocations (e.g. a monotonic sequence number), do not conflate the two: keep the existing --flush form untouched for the retiring field (other callers may still legitimately want it) and add a NEW, narrowly-scoped --flush-seq-style form for the field that must keep persisting, called at every one of its own mint sites even if those sites run before a shared helper library is sourced.

When a test suite documents itself as resolving its subject-under-test deploy-tree-first (validating 'what actually runs in production'), a source-store-only edit will show as a genuine test failure until redeployed -- this is not a bug in the edit. Verify correctness before redeploying by temporarily copying the source-store file over the deployed copy, running the suite, then reverting the deployed copy to its exact prior byte content (never leaving a lasting hand-edit under a disposable deploy-artifact directory).
